verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change remains correct and complete under the trust-plane review lens. Terminal reaping now requires the union of the existing fresh open-pull walk and a separately keyed, single-page ref/head corroboration for each candidate. Full or malformed responses and request failures defer only the affected claim; successful results are merged before the existing App-author, same-repository, worker-marker identity gate is applied. Exact request paths, issue-prefix isolation, multi-head accumulation, positive retention, negative release, outsider rejection, full-page refusal, and scoped failure behavior are exercised non-vacuously. The documented deleted-head plus concurrent walk-skip residual is explicit and is not worsened by this patch. No reviewer-directed instruction was detected in the diff. Round 3 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant rather than improving under the required comparison scale.
